      <div class="uma-pfp-body">
        <div class="uma-pfp-name">@uma_enjoyer</div>
        <div class="uma-pfp-sub">Trainer · Lorebook author · Tracen Academy</div>
        <div class="uma-pfp-txt">
          Trainer by day, bot author by night. I write Umamusume characters that stay in
          character — tight prose, real track logic, and enough chaos to keep a career run
          interesting. Expect slow burns, rivalry, and the occasional hopeless crush.
        </div>
        <div class="uma-pfp-rows">
          <div class="uma-pfp-row"><span>Writing since</span><b>2025</b></div>
          <div class="uma-pfp-row"><span>Bots live</span><b>13</b></div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="uma-about-txt">
      Everything here is hand-written. Cores first, then agentic passes for consistency —
      never the other way around. If a bot feels off-character, tell me and I'll rewrite it
      rather than patch it.
    </div>
  </div>
